name: sf-to-dataverse
description: Root-level package.json for the SF-to-Dataverse PoC. The Salesforce LWC Jest tests under src/salesforce/force-app/main/default/lwc run via @salesforce/sfdx-lwc-jest, which expects to be invoked from the repo root (where sfdx-project.json lives). The Azure Jest tests under src/azure/test have their own pipeline (cd src/azure && npm test) and are explicitly ignored here so the LWC runner never tries to transform them with its LWC-only Babel preset.
